small, it still needs tending. We have no household help, and so I cook and sweep, knit and sew, and run errands— I’m always on my feet— and mother will be so strict about just everything! Not that we have to be, you know, we could be freer with money than most. My father left us a tidy sum, and a cottage and garden just outside town. But I live mainly a quiet life now. My brother’s a soldier, my little sister’s dead. I had some difficult times with her, but I'd gladly live them all over again, I loved her so.

@@U01413@@
She must have been an angel if she was like you.

@@U01415@@
I brought her up myself. Oh, she loved me so! She was born after my father died. We gave up mother for lost, she was so badly off. But then, little by little she began to come round. Still, of course, she couldn’t dream of nursing the poor thing, she was so weak, so I made do feeding it with milk and water, and that’s how she came to be mine. And so she grew big, in my arms, on my lap, squirming, kicking, smiling.

@@U01417@@
That must have been the sheerest happiness for you.
translation:
@@U01411@@
虽小，仍需照料。我们没有家务帮手，所以我做饭、扫地、编织、缝纫、跑腿——我总是能站稳脚跟——而母亲对一切都会如此严格！你知道，这并不是说我们必须如此，我们在金钱上可以比大多数人更自由。我父亲给我们留下了一大笔钱，以及城外的一座小屋和花园。但我现在主要过着平静的生活。我哥哥是一名士兵，我妹妹死了。我和她一起度过了一些困难的时光，但我很乐意重新经历这些，我非常爱她。

@@U01413@@
如果她像你一样，她一定是天使。

@@U01415@@
我自己把她带大的。哦，她是如此爱我！她是我父亲去世后出生的。我们因为失去了母亲而放弃了她，她的处境非常糟糕。但后来，她渐渐醒悟了。当然，她仍然无法梦想去喂养这个可怜的东西，她太虚弱了，所以我勉强用牛奶和水喂养它，这就是她成为我的原因。于是她就长大了，在我的怀里，在我的腿上，蠕动、踢腿、微笑。

@@U01417@@
这对你来说一定是最纯粹的幸福。
